notes.title: It's about time to jump into Dylan's life whirlpool! My Shameless StepMom is out
notes.content:
Our new meticulously crafted story is finally released and is waiting for everyone who's brave enough to try to solve the riddle Dylan found himself in the middle of. A twisted situation with a stepmother, shady plans your friends are onto, a bunch of problems to wrap your head around, and confusing feelings and emotions about the people around will catch you off guard - and you'll be the one trying to deal with that local detective story of his! If you're one of the fans and was waiting for a game to come out - you may have gotten lucky. We've prepared a few free keys for the most concerned fans - try them out, you might be just on time!

notes.title: Just a few days till you'll be able to help Dylan navigate through his daily cha
notes.content: Life can be a tricky thing, especially in a situation where Dylan, the main character of our soon-to-be-released My Shameless StepMom, found himself. Father mysteriously disappears, his father's wife seems to be somewhat hostile to him and the waiter at his favourite place seems to be onto something.. criminal?! Dive into the hot, detective-like story, where complicated life situations and tangled relationships result in all kinds of outcomes, many of which are intriguing and fiery 👀 Game will provide players with a unique storyline, remarkable characters, hot adult content and much more. Make sure to hop on the game page one of the first if you're really interested - but we won't tell you why exactly 😯
